secrets.name: The Maintenance Tunnel
secrets.text: Under the road there is a tunnel for the people who look after it: pipes, cables, a desk with a telephone and a logbook. Every entry in the logbook says the same thing: No traffic.

meta.label: The Motorway
meta.blurb: A motorway, three hundred yards of it, lit orange, running through the library from a tunnel to a tunnel. There is no traffic. There has never been any traffic. You look both ways anyway.
